cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 64% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX +0.43% · BTC +0.42% · Gold +0.83% · Nasdaq100 +0.33%. At the last close, 64% of 101 AI names were green — a broad bid. Applied AI: Industrial, Defense & Vertical did the heavy lifting at +2.33%.

cards.headline: Applied AI: Industrial, Defense & Vertical leads, AI Chips & Compute lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is Applied AI: Industrial, Defense & Vertical at +2.33%; weakest is AI Chips & Compute at -1.14%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.
